races.verdict: CELTIC STORM is shaping up well, appreciating the increase in trip and improving on his debut form when posting a good third at Kempton (1m) 16 days ago. He appeals as the type to go on progressing and can make a successful switch to turf under Billy Loughnane. Charmed Boy may emerge best of the newcomers, whilst Pen Lan Icon is another to note now her stamina is tested further. CELTIC STORM (FR) CHARMED BOY (IRE) PEN LAN ICON

races.verdict: APPLE'S OF BRESIL could hardly have been more impressive on his chase debut and, already proven when fresh, is taken to follow up en route to better things. Ocastle des Mottes has improved his jumping of late, culminating in a win last time, and he rates as the main danger if producing another clear round. Sky Lord also arrives on the back of a win and can feature if seeing things out as well again. APPLE'S OF BRESIL (FR) OCASTLE DES MOTTES (FR) SKY LORD
